page.overview:
What is The Upside Down?

The Upside Down is a dark and eldritch parallel dimension featured in the Netflix urban fantasy series Stranger Things. It is a twisted, decaying mirror image of the real world, specifically the town of Hawkins, Indiana. It is filled with grotesque creatures and an ever-growing, malevolent force known as the Mind Flayer. Once a parallel dimension, it was irrevocably altered when child psychic Eleven opened a gate between the two worlds, allowing the horrors within to seep into the human realm.

Since then, it has been a constant threat to Hawkins, with its influence growing stronger as the series progresses. The Mind Flayer, a powerful entity from this dimension, seeks to merge the Upside Down with the real world, creating a horrifying new reality.
